result.question: What does Tesla disclose about its dependence on Elon Musk?
result.answer:
Tesla discloses in its 10-K risk factors that it is "highly dependent on the services of Elon Musk, Technoking of Tesla and our Chief Executive Officer" [0001628280-25-003063:item-1a-p016] [0001628280-26-003952:item-1a-p016]. Within its risk factor on attracting and retaining key employees, Tesla states that the loss of the services of any of its key employees could disrupt operations or delay the development, introduction and ramp of its products and services, and that in particular it is highly dependent on Mr. Musk's services; it also notes that none of its key employees is bound by an employment agreement for any specific term [0001628280-25-003063:item-1a-p015] [0001628280-26-003952:item-1a-p016].

Tesla further discloses that although Mr. Musk spends significant time with Tesla and is highly active in its management, he does not devote his full time and attention to Tesla [0001628280-25-003063:item-1a-p016] [0001628280-26-003952:item-1a-p017]. In its 10-K filed January 30, 2025, Tesla notes that Mr. Musk also currently holds management positions at Space Exploration Technologies Corp., X Corp., X.AI Corp., Neuralink Corp. and The Boring Company, and is involved in other ventures and with the Department of Government Efficiency [0001628280-25-003063:item-1a-p016]. In its 10-K filed January 29, 2026, Tesla lists his management positions at Space Exploration Technologies Corp., X.AI Holdings Corp. ("xAI"), Neuralink Corp. and The Boring Company, and his involvement in other ventures [0001628280-26-003952:item-1a-p017].

Tesla also discloses stock-price risks tied to Mr. Musk: certain banking institutions have made extensions of credit to Mr. Musk, a portion of which was used to purchase shares of Tesla common stock, and these loans are partially secured by pledges of a portion of the Tesla common stock he owns [0001628280-25-003063:item-1a-p034]. If the price of Tesla's common stock were to decline substantially, Mr. Musk may be forced by one or more banking institutions to sell shares of Tesla common stock to satisfy his loan obligations, and any such sales could cause the price of Tesla's common stock to decline further [0001628280-25-003063:item-1a-p034] [0001628280-26-003952:item-1a-p035]. The 2026 10-K adds that Mr. Musk may also sell a portion of his shares in order to satisfy tax obligations relating to the 2018 CEO Performance Award, and that any such sales could cause the price of Tesla's common stock to decline [0001628280-26-003952:item-1a-p035].

Regarding compensation and retention, Tesla's filings describe the litigation over the 2018 CEO Performance Award: on January 30, 2024, the Delaware Court of Chancery issued an opinion finding that the 2018 CEO Performance Award should be rescinded, and Tesla's disinterested stockholders voted to ratify the 2018 CEO Performance Award at Tesla's 2024 Annual Meeting of Stockholders [0001628280-25-018911:part-i--item-1-p014]. On December 19, 2025, the Delaware Supreme Court reversed the Court of Chancery's rescission order, reinstating the 2018 CEO Performance Award [0001628280-26-026673:part-ii--item-5-p001]. Following that reinstatement, on April 21, 2026 the Board approved the determination that the final order allowing Mr. Musk to exercise the 2018 CEO Performance Award in full constituted a Tornetta Decision Event, resulting in the immediate forfeiture of the 2025 CEO Interim Award by Mr. Musk, consistent with the "no double dip" principle precluding Mr. Musk from getting a windfall [0001628280-26-026673:part-i--item-1-p014]. Tesla also discloses that a Special Committee of the Board consisting of disinterested directors Robyn Denholm and Kathleen Wilson-Thompson reconvened to consider, evaluate and determine all aspects of the retention and incentivization of Mr. Musk, and that on April 21, 2026 the Board (with Mr. Elon Musk and Mr. Kimbal Musk recused) approved the Company's entry into the Implementation Agreement, implementing a process for Mr. Musk's exercise of the 2018 CEO Performance Award intended to mitigate any negative impact of significant share sales on the Company [0001628280-26-026673:part-ii--item-5-p001].
